mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 3-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand contraction that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial slowdowns (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing output contraction signals economic deterioration that typically drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) relative to its 6-month moving average indicates strong economic growth that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 is above its 6-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high interest rate regimes (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), further rate hikes suppress equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
